# 1 Enoch Chapter 70 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 70:1 — 'his name was raised aloft to that Son of Man' — the identity question

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "his-name-during-his-lifetime was-raised-aloft to-that-Son-of-Man and-to-the-Lord-of-Spirits" | Literal; 'to' = in the presence of / upward toward |
| LOGOS | "his name during his lifetime was raised aloft to that Son of Man and to the Lord of Spirits" | Agrees; preserves the ambiguity |
| PNEUMA | "his name was lifted up before that Son of Man and before the Lord of Spirits" | 'Before' rather than 'to' — slightly different directional sense |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The Ge'ez preposition (qedama / mesle) here is genuinely ambiguous — Enoch's name could be raised 'to' (i.e., identified with) the Son of Man, or raised 'before' (in the presence of) the Son of Man. This ambiguity is deliberate and prepares for 71:14. Neither LOGOS nor PNEUMA resolves it; both are acceptable. LOGOS's 'to' preserves the directional sense most literally.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Deliberate ambiguity preserved.

---

## 70:2 — 'chariots of the spirit' — the vehicle of Enoch's translation

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-chariots-of-the-spirit" | Literal; Ge'ez 'erqaban = chariots |
| LOGOS | "the chariots of the spirit" | Agrees |
| PNEUMA | "the chariots of the spirit" | Agrees |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Full convergence. 'Chariots of the spirit' is the Enochic parallel to Elijah's translation 'in a whirlwind' with 'chariots of fire' (2 Kgs 2:11). The image of heavenly chariots as the vehicle of divine transport is preserved by all three translators.

**Status:** Full convergence.

---

## 70:4 — 'the first fathers' — who are they?

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-first-fathers" | Literal; the antediluvian patriarchs |
| LOGOS | "the first fathers" | Agrees |
| PNEUMA | "the first ancestors" | 'Ancestors' is more natural English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'first fathers' (EMET/LOGOS). The Ge'ez 'ab is specifically 'fathers' — the antediluvian patriarchs who preceded the Flood. 'Ancestors' (PNEUMA) is correct but loses the specifically patriarchal/genealogical connotation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---
